```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(biomaRt)
library(Biostrings)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)

theme_set(theme_classic())

result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"
```

# Read in data

## Load mutation information

```{r}
mut_data = fread(file.path(result_dir, "step7c_mutations_peptides_17.tsv"))
dim(mut_data)
mut_data[1:2,]

length(unique(mut_data$key))

table(nchar(mut_data$wildtype), nchar(mut_data$mutant))
mut_data = mut_data[nchar(wildtype) == 17 & nchar(mutant) == 17,]
dim(mut_data)

mut_data_ii = fread(file.path(result_dir, "step7c_mutations_peptides_29.tsv"))
dim(mut_data_ii)
mut_data_ii[1:2,]

length(unique(mut_data_ii$key))

table(nchar(mut_data_ii$wildtype), nchar(mut_data_ii$mutant))
mut_data_ii = mut_data_ii[nchar(wildtype) == 29 & nchar(mutant) == 29,]
dim(mut_data_ii)
```

## Read in selected mutations

### Mutations included in cross valiation study
```{r}
mutation_file = "cv_optimal_pcut_both_mut_cancer_combos.tsv"

mut_dat0 = fread(file.path(result_dir, "_cross_validation", mutation_file))
dim(mut_dat0)
mut_dat0[1:2,]

mut_dat2 <- mut_dat0[, .(cancer, auc, pcut_A, pcut_B, key_pro)]

# order by key_pro and descending auc
setorder(mut_dat2, key_pro, -auc)

# collapse rows with same key_pro
mut_dat_cv <- mut_dat2[, .(
  cancer  = paste(cancer, collapse = ","),
  auc     = paste(auc, collapse = ","),
  pcut_A  = paste(pcut_A, collapse = ","),
  pcut_B  = paste(pcut_B, collapse = ",")
), by = key_pro]

dim(mut_dat_cv)
mut_dat_cv[1:5,]
```

### Mutations that are associated with many TCRs
```{r}
mut_dat1 = fread(file.path(result_dir, "step8_mutation_by_nTCR.tsv"))
dim(mut_dat1)
mut_dat1[1:2,]
table(mut_dat1$neoantigen, mut_dat1$nTCRA >= 30 & mut_dat1$nTCRB >= 10)
table(mut_dat1$neoantigen, mut_dat1$nTCRA >= 50 & mut_dat1$nTCRB >= 30)

setnames(mut_dat1, "mutation", "key_pro")

table(mut_dat1$Freq.x == mut_dat1$Freq.y)
mut_dat1$Freq <- mut_dat1$Freq.x
mut_dat1$Freq.y <- NULL
mut_dat1$Freq.x <- NULL
mut_dat1$Variant_Classification <- NULL

table(mut_dat1$nTCRA >= 50, mut_dat1$nTCRB >= 30)
mut_dat_by_TCR = mut_dat1[nTCRA >=50 & nTCRB >= 30,]
dim(mut_dat_by_TCR)
mut_dat_by_TCR[1:2,]
```

# Prepare input for NetMHCpan4.1

## Merge the data

```{r}

mut_data[, key_pro := paste(Hugo_Symbol, gsub("p.", "", HGVSp_Short, 
                                              fixed = TRUE), sep=":")]

dim(mut_data)
mut_data[1:2,]

table(mut_dat_cv$key_pro %in% mut_data$key_pro)
setdiff(mut_dat_cv$key_pro, mut_data$key_pro)
table(mut_dat_by_TCR$key_pro %in% mut_data$key_pro)

mut_dat_by_TCR[mut_dat_by_TCR$key_pro %in% mut_dat_cv$key_pro,]

mut_data = mut_data[key_pro %in% union(mut_dat_cv$key_pro, mut_dat_by_TCR$key_pro)]
dim(mut_data)
mut_data[1:2,]

mut_data = merge(mut_data, mut_dat_cv, all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
mut_data = merge(mut_data, mut_dat1, all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)

mut_data[,Tumor_Sample_Barcode := NULL]
mut_data[,participant := NULL]
mut_data[,n := NULL]

dim(mut_data)
mut_data[1:2,]

table(mut_data$neoantigen)

fwrite(mut_data, file=file.path(result_dir, "step8_mut_data_HLA_I.tsv"), sep="\t")
mut_data[neoantigen == TRUE,]

```

## Write out fasta files

The input for NetMHCpan4.1 is a fasta file like the following. 
```
>seq1
ASTPGHTIIYEAVCLHNDRTTIP
```

```{r}
mut_data = mut_data[order(mut_data$key),]

pep_ref = rep("", 2*nrow(mut_data))
pep_mut = rep("", 2*nrow(mut_data))

pep_ref[seq(1, length(pep_ref), 2)] = paste0(">", mut_data$key_pro, ":WT")
pep_ref[seq(2, length(pep_ref), 2)] = mut_data$wildtype

pep_mut[seq(1, length(pep_mut), 2)] = paste0(">", mut_data$key_pro, ":MT")
pep_mut[seq(2, length(pep_mut), 2)] = mut_data$mutant

cat(pep_ref, file=file.path(result_dir, "step8_nM_TCGA_peptides_ref.fasta"), sep="\n")
cat(pep_mut, file=file.path(result_dir, "step8_nM_TCGA_peptides_mut.fasta"), sep="\n")
```

# Prepare input for NetMHCIIpan

## Merge the data

```{r}

mut_data_ii[, key_pro := paste(Hugo_Symbol, gsub("p.", "", HGVSp_Short, 
                                              fixed = TRUE), sep=":")]

dim(mut_data_ii)
mut_data_ii[1:2,]

table(mut_dat_cv$key_pro %in% mut_data_ii$key_pro)
setdiff(mut_dat_cv$key_pro, mut_data_ii$key_pro)
table(mut_dat_by_TCR$key_pro %in% mut_data_ii$key_pro)
setdiff(mut_dat_by_TCR$key_pro, mut_data_ii$key_pro)

mut_data_ii = mut_data_ii[key_pro %in% union(mut_dat_cv$key_pro, mut_dat_by_TCR$key_pro)]
dim(mut_data_ii)
mut_data_ii[1:2,]

mut_data_ii = merge(mut_data_ii, mut_dat_cv, all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
mut_data_ii = merge(mut_data_ii, mut_dat1, all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)

mut_data_ii[,Tumor_Sample_Barcode := NULL]
mut_data_ii[,participant := NULL]
mut_data_ii[,n := NULL]

dim(mut_data_ii)
mut_data_ii[1:2,]

fwrite(mut_data_ii, file=file.path(result_dir, "step8_mut_data_HLA_II.tsv"), sep="\t")
mut_data_ii[neoantigen == TRUE,]

```

## Write out fasta files


```{r}
mut_data_ii = mut_data_ii[order(mut_data_ii$key),]

pep_ref = rep("", 2*nrow(mut_data_ii))
pep_mut = rep("", 2*nrow(mut_data_ii))

pep_ref[seq(1, length(pep_ref), 2)] = paste0(">", mut_data_ii$key_pro, ":WT")
pep_ref[seq(2, length(pep_ref), 2)] = mut_data_ii$wildtype

pep_mut[seq(1, length(pep_mut), 2)] = paste0(">", mut_data_ii$key_pro, ":MT")
pep_mut[seq(2, length(pep_mut), 2)] = mut_data_ii$mutant

cat(pep_ref, file=file.path(result_dir, "step8_nM_TCGA_peptides_ref_HLA_II.fasta"), sep="\n")
cat(pep_mut, file=file.path(result_dir, "step8_nM_TCGA_peptides_mut_HLA_II.fasta"), sep="\n")
```
